text.en:
The percentage of dividends for years 2003, 2004 and 2005
to be remitted by LBP to the National Government, which are composed of:
PERCENTAGE
2005
- At least eight hundred million

2/
five hundred million (P500 M)
stock dividends
2004
At least seven hundred million
six hundred million (P600 M)
stock dividends
2003
At least six hundred million (P600 M)
cash and eight hundred seventy one
million (P871 M) stock dividends

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 9th day of
the year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Seven.
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
